_comment_times: Times to take screenshots daily (24h format) - default twice a day 9am and 9pm
_comment_headless: true = runs hidden in background, false = you see browser (for testing)
_comment_screenshot: true = full page, false = visible area only
_comment_wait: Seconds to wait after login before screenshot
_comment_selectors: OPTIONAL - Leave empty for auto-detect. Only fill if auto-login fails
